title: Computer Use Research Preview in Claude Code
description: March 23, 2026 release adds computer use capabilities to Claude Code and Cowork, allowing Claude to interact with your computer system including browser automation and local file operations. Available to Pro and Max plan subscribers. Also includes Dispatch improvements for task management.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is still an amazing, if not the best way to write code. Adding these computer use tools into Claude Code makes it an even more compelling product
If we get reliable computer use models in 2026 or 2027, I probably won't ever hire anybody
The problem is that AI creates technical debt faster than we can pay it off
I use Supabase, PostgreSQL, n8n, and Claude Code every day to build and ship production systems
2026 is where it gets very real because of Claude Code. Developers using 4-10 terminals simultaneously

title: Version 2.1.85 - Latest Release
description: Added environment variables for MCP headersHelper scripts, conditional 'if' field for hooks, timestamp markers for scheduled tasks, and numerous bug fixes including crash fixes, memory leaks, and improved performance for large repositories.

title: Wave3 Update
description: Enhanced AI editing experience with multiple new features released by the Exafunction team. February 20, 2025 update.

title: Devin 2.0 Launch
description: Major update launched April 2025 featuring agent-native IDE experience, new pricing starting at $20/month, and enterprise features. API v2 Enterprise launch referenced for March 2025.

title: GPT-5-Codex Integration
description: September 2025 major upgrade making GPT-5-Codex available to developers via API key. November 19, 2025 brought GPT-5-Codex-Max release.

title: Version 0.21.0 - Gemini 3 Flash Integration
description: December 15, 2025 release integrating Gemini 3 Flash for better, faster, and cheaper performance. Previous updates include VSCode deep integration (August 2025) and intelligent model routing (October 2025).
